data.heading: Salesforce expertise, backed by AI and data engineering

blocks.body: Agivant helps enterprises get more out of Salesforce with AI engineering, Agentforce, generative AI, intelligent automation, data platforms, and cloud engineering. As a Salesforce Consulting Partner, Agivant helps organizations modernize customer experiences, automate workflows, raise productivity, and scale AI adoption across Sales, Service, IT, and Commerce.

blocks.statement: Agivant pairs Salesforce expertise with enterprise data and cloud engineering, so CRM workflows built on manual steps start running on live data and AI assistance.

data.heading: What Agivant brings to Salesforce
data.description: Agivant brings together Salesforce consulting, Agentforce implementation, GenAI, intelligent automation, engineering productivity, data platforms, and observability, so organizations get measurable returns from the Salesforce platform they already run.

blocks.body: Salesforce and Agentforce implementation mapped to business objectives and enterprise workflows
AI-enabled customer and employee experiences across Sales, Service, Commerce, and IT
GenAI-powered automation for sales assistance, service workflows, development, testing, and operations
Salesforce-connected data, analytics, observability, and AI-driven infrastructure capabilities
Composable accelerators that shorten adoption and move use cases into production faster
Engineering-led delivery focused on productivity, customer experience, reliability, and measurable business outcomes

data.heading: Featured Salesforce solutions
data.description: Each solution applies AI and customer intelligence to one focused sales or engineering use case.

blocks.title: AI-powered sales conversion
blocks.body: An AI sales assistant built on Salesforce with Vertex AI and Gemini supports reps from pre-call preparation through live conversations to post-call analysis.
blocks.solution: 50–75% reduction in research time, 20% increase in call volume, 15–20% improvement in close rates, and 10–15% increase in revenue growth.

blocks.title: GenAI-driven Salesforce developer productivity
blocks.body: Agivant brings GenAI and Gemini to Salesforce development, so teams code, test, and debug faster
items: Apex and Lightning Web Components assistance
Test case and test asset generation
blocks.solution: 30–40% automation of repetitive coding and 10–15% reduction in debugging time.

blocks.title: AI-powered sustainability insights
blocks.body: The Sustainability Planner combines Salesforce CRM with GenAI to find sustainability-focused customers and read their priorities, so sales teams go into each conversation informed.
blocks.solution: 15% increase in upsell success rates and 25–30% improvement in sales engagement efficiency.
